output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minting tokens, the initialSupply is multiplied by 10^uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.
The transfer function has a wrong logic in the assert statement. The function asserts that balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to] == previousBalances, which can be false due to integer overflow.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When decreasing the allowance, if the allowance is large enough, the new allowance can underflow to a large positive value, causing an integer overflow in the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; function.
The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minting tokens, the initialSupply is multiplied by 10^uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.
The mintToken function has a devalue issue. The owner can mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any target address, causing severe devaluation of the token.
